The Problem With Traditional Learning

Students struggle because existing tools weren't designed for real learning

❌

Generic Chatbots

No memory, no structure, no personalization. Every session starts from scratch.

❌

YouTube Tutorials

One-way communication. Can't ask questions or get personalized help.

❌

Study Groups

Not available 24/7. Scheduling conflicts. Different learning paces.

{/* HOW IT WORKS - Light Gray */}

How Saarthi Works

Structured learning designed around how students actually study

Step 1

Choose Your Subject & Tutor

Select from specialized AI tutors: Omkar for AI & ML, Priya for Biology. Each tutor has unique teaching styles and expertise.

  • Voice-enabled 3D avatars
  • Subject-specialized knowledge
  • Adaptive teaching methods
🧑‍💻
💬
Step 2

Start a Learning Session

Talk or type naturally. Ask questions, request explanations, or work through problems together. Every conversation is saved automatically.

  • Real-time voice interaction
  • Persistent chat history
  • Built-in note-taking
Step 3

Resume Anytime, Anywhere

Saarthi remembers every session, every question, and your learning progress. Pick up exactly where you left off.

  • Full session history
  • Progress tracking
  • Context-aware conversations
📚
{/* WHY CHOOSE SAARTHI - Dark Background */}

Why Saarthi Over ChatGPT or YouTube?

Purpose-built for structured, persistent learning

Session-Based Learning

Unlike random ChatGPT conversations, Saarthi organizes learning into structured sessions. Each session builds on previous knowledge with full context retention.

Memory-Aware AI

Remembers your doubts, progress, learning style, and where you stopped. Resume conversations months later with full context.

Voice + Visual Learning

Talk naturally with realistic 3D avatars. Feels like a real tutor, not typing into a text box. Hands-free learning while taking notes.

Built for Students

Not a general-purpose chatbot. Specifically designed for education with features like note-taking, progress tracking, and concept explanations.

{/* TUTORS - White Background */}

Meet Your AI Tutors

Expert AI companions specialized in different subjects

🧑‍💻

Omkar

AI & Machine Learning

Explains AI concepts like a senior software engineer. Breaks down complex algorithms, neural networks, and ML theory into practical, understandable examples.

Machine Learning Deep Learning Python
👩‍🔬

Priya

Biology

Makes biology intuitive through visual thinking. Connects cellular processes to real-world examples and helps you understand life sciences from first principles.

Cell Biology Genetics Ecology

Education is not a race. It is a journey of understanding.

Saarthi exists to give every student a personal guide — someone who listens, adapts, and walks beside them.

Not a chatbot. Not a search engine.

A companion.
